name: OpenSSL 1.0.1 - Heartbleed Memory Disclosure
description: OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f (TLS heartbeat extension) allows remote attackers to read process memory, potentially disclosing private keys, session data, and credentials.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later and rotate any keys/credentials that may have been exposed.
